يعتزلن (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِلْنَ (yaʕtazilna) /jaʕ.ta.zil.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# يُعْتَزَلْنَ (yuʕtazalna) /juʕ.ta.zal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
